blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court is optimistic that the Supreme Court will immediately rule on the petitions challenging its decision to reduce the number of votes needed to convict or acquit Vice President Sara Duterte. “Yes, that’s the expectation of our presiding officer [Sen. Francis Escudero] and the whole impeachment court. That’s why he also mentioned that he doesn’t want any issue to crop up beyond 2027,” impeachment court spokesperson Reginald Tongol said in a radio interview on dzBB on Sunday. The impeachment court, Tongol added, is hoping the high tribunal would make its ruling before the senator-judges vote […]...
